## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `discord-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to Discord Developer Portal

1. <!-- manual: Access the [Discord developer portal](https://discord.com/login?redirect_to=%2Fdevelopers) using your Discord credentials. -->
2. If you don't have a Discord account, select **Register** beneath the login button and complete account creation.

## Step 3: Create a new Discord application

1. In the developer portal, select **New Application**.

## Step 4: Name the Discord application

1. <!-- manual: Provide a name for your application and accept the terms of service. -->
2. Select **Next** to complete naming.

## Step 5: Obtain the client ID and client secret

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to OAuth2 in the sidebar to retrieve your client credentials. You need the Client ID and Client Secret to use the Discord connector. -->
